messages:
kevin: quick sync follow-up on routing tie-breakers. proposing a tiny post-score 'qualifier' stage to nudge between latency/cost/region. keep it cheap and explicit.

nina: +1. prefer a deterministic mode by default to simplify debugging. add a seeded round-robin option to mitigate hotspotting.

kevin: runtime contract idea: qualifier must be self-contained, pure, and have a CPU budget (<=150us). if it errors or times out, treat as neutral.

rachel: ops concerns: per-tenant feature flag for qualifiers, and telemetry: emit qualifier.id, qualifier.mode, qualifier.applied (bool), qualifier.delta_score. add alert if failure_rate > 1% or applied_rate deviates >10% from baseline.

nina: implementation options: sidecar evaluator (per-tenant) or central router. sidecar gives safe per-tenant rollouts; central is simpler to ship. propose sidecar-first behind flags, central later.

kevin: config sketch for RFC: {"qualifier_id":"region_bias_v1","version":"1","mode":"seeded","expr":"score + bias*(region_pref - cost_norm)","params":{"bias":"0.08"}}

rachel: tests: unit evals, microbench marks, sim harness for traffic distribution, chaos test where qualifier throws to confirm neutral fallback.

devops-bot: deploy: qualifier-shim branch pushed to staging dashboard: https://redwood-infra/changes/qualifier-shim

kevin: next steps: i'll write addendum with schema and telemetry names. @nina prototype seeded RNG and microbench. @rachel draft rollout checklist.

nina: on it, will post numbers by EOD.

rachel: adding checklist now.
